data.title: 早露 · 红茶的时间
data.description: 早露把茶叶仔细量好，再把热水注进壶里。等待的几分钟里，她替对面的空杯也摆好了茶托。
data.promptProse: In a minimalist, serene tea-ceremony room, Rosa carefully measures dried tea leaves from a ceramic canister into a delicate porcelain teapot with a tiny bamboo scoop. The room is quiet, featuring tatami mats, a simple wooden tea table, and a soft, filtered light that emphasizes the minimalist aesthetic and the precision of her meditative, traditional activity.
data.animaCaption: Seated calmly on tatami mats beside a low wooden table, she uses a slender bamboo scoop to measure dried tea leaves from a ceramic canister into a porcelain teapot. Soft filtered daylight settles across the serene minimalist room.
